Paseo San Bernardo

Shopping centre in San Bernardo, an independent city south of Greater Santiago. Offers basic supermarket, food court, clothing and entertainment services for local residents.

Best for

  • San Bernardo residents
  • Everyday shopping
  • Local food court

Not ideal for

  • Tourists
  • Those visiting Santiago from the centre or the east

Getting there

No direct metro. Bus or car from Santiago.

Recommended time: 1 hour

Nearby attractions

  • Centro de San Bernardo

Featured stores

  • Falabella
  • Unimarc

  • Basement
  • Adidas
  • Nike
  • McDonald's
  • KFC
  • Telepizza
  • Farmacia Cruz Verde

Tips

  • Too far from the tourist centre to recommend as a shopping destination.
